name: 手写风格
rights_status: NERO-native rule system; user-supplied visual reference only; no external assets or fonts bundled
style_positioning: A warm editorial research-note system that combines concise conclusion-led writing, handwritten text and numerals, hand-drawn chart geometry, yellow marker emphasis, green data traces, generous paper space, and deterministic evidence layers.

response-inline.use_for: Short conclusion-led replies with annotation rhythm; the renderer controls actual font and background.

image-report-landscape.use_for: Research cards, stock or company comparisons, and annotated chart explainers.

web-ppt-16x9.use_for: Self-contained HTML report or web-PPT with responsive recomposition.

pptx-16x9.use_for: Editable PPTX slide using native text, chart, and vector annotation objects.

strict-handwritten-horizontal-16x9.use_for: Strict handwriting master for landscape research banners; every visible glyph and chart mark must resolve to a handwriting treatment.

expression: 关键数字用轻量标记强调
保留判断边界和下一步
response.renderer_boundary: Chat UI may not expose custom font, marker background, or ink texture. Preserve the style through sentence rhythm and restrained annotation syntax.

image-report.text_treatment: registered handwritten font and deterministic per-glyph variation
image-report.strict_text_treatment: resolved CJK handwriting/calligraphic font plus per-glyph variation; fail closed when unresolved
image-report.strict_chart_treatment: hand-authored paths only; no default bar/grid/card primitives
image-report.annotation_layer: SVG marker, underline, circle, strike-through, and hand-drawn axis primitives

web-ppt-html.responsive_rule: Recompose the conclusion block and chart; do not shrink the desktop canvas mechanically.
web-ppt-html.interaction_rule: Use motion only to reveal a relationship or focus an annotation; respect reduced motion.

ppt.annotation_objects: native vector shapes or editable SVG
ppt.font_rule: Strict master resolves an approved local CJK handwriting/display font and fails closed; non-strict formal adapters may use a readable fallback only when explicitly selected.

use_for: HTML research reports and web-PPT chapter pages
PPT research conclusions and section openers
avoid_for: dense banker appendices or audit schedules
exact text or chart labels generated inside a raster image
childlike doodle treatment or decorative scrapbook density
a new project being called visual_ready without its own QA

registration.visual_baseline: pending representative image-report, web-html, and editable-pptx samples
